title: Android CheckBox: custom button tint modes
purpose: Compare Android XML buttonTintMode values on the same custom CheckBox button drawable.
changes: Added six explicit tint modes for supported custom CheckBox and RadioButton shapes.
steps: Find Custom button tint modes below the RTL switch. Each row names a tint mode and shows the same amber shape tinted with translucent blue.
Compare the shapes: src_in is translucent blue, src_atop mixes blue and amber, and multiply appears dark. The other modes also produce their own colors.
Tap the rows and turn on Right-to-left layout. Their shapes should move to the right and retain their colors.
Choose OK if the page looks and behaves correctly, or Reject with the failing row and your device.
expected: Each tint mode composes the same source shape and tint independently; CheckBox input and RTL placement continue to work.
limits: Explicit modes apply only to supported custom solid shapes. Built-in button drawable tint modes, other drawable types, edge compositing and Android device pixel parity remain open.

references.scope: Button drawable tint mode and state.

validation: 149 Android XML importer tests passed, covering all six modes on CheckBox and RadioButton and unsupported inputs.
Rust rendering test verifies src_atop composition for both custom CheckBox and RadioButton.
